commit.message:
feat(auth): session-cookie login/logout/me and require_role()

Signed HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie (itsdangerous), bcrypt
password hashing (passlib), and POST /api/auth/login, POST
/api/auth/logout, GET /api/auth/me (§6 "Auth"). require_role() is a
FastAPI dependency factory returning 401 when unauthenticated and 403
(reusing the T0 error shape) when the user's app_role doesn't match
(P12).

Wires the auth router into app/main.py and regenerates openapi.json.

tests/test_auth.py covers require_role's role check directly (no DB),
and the full login/me/logout/403 round trip over HTTP against a real
Postgres.

Pins bcrypt<4.1: passlib 1.7's backend-detection probe raises on
bcrypt>=4.1's changed API.

feat(server): JWT login in an httpOnly cookie, auth middleware, logout

- New auth module: POST /api/v1/auth/register, /login, /logout and
  GET /auth/me. Register and login set a 'token' cookie (httpOnly,
  SameSite=Lax by default, Secure in production); logout clears it.
  v1 login now returns the user object; the legacy /user/user/login
  keeps its array response and sets the same cookie.
- middleware/auth.js: requireAuth verifies the token and reloads the
  user from the database (deleted accounts and role changes apply at
  once); requireRole('admin', 'vendor', ...) returns 403 for other
  roles and 401 when nobody is logged in.
- Tokens are signed with JWT_SECRET; the server refuses to start unless
  it is set to 32+ characters. SESSION_DAYS and COOKIE_SAMESITE are
  optional (.env.example documents all three).
- No routes are protected yet; that is the next commit.

Adds tests/auth.test.js (cookie flags, /me, logout, forged/expired/
orphaned tokens, requireRole) and a tests/helpers/auth.js helper that
logs in as each role.

fix: resolve logout-on-action bug and default meal plans for non-subscribers

Bug 1 — Immediate logout on action:
- Remove destructive beforeunload handler from Shell.tsx that was clearing session on ANY page unload
- Add 401 interceptor in api.ts: auto-clears session and redirects to /login on token expiry
- Clean up Shell timer logic

Bug 2 — Default plan to none for non-subscribers:
- PUT /admin/:id/role now resets mealBreakfast/Lunch/Dinner to false when role changes away from subscriber
- PUT /admin/users/:id now resets meals for non-subscriber role changes
- Startup fixup: resets stale meal booleans on all non-subscriber users
- Frontend: save() in users page only sends meal data for subscriber role

fix: prevent HOD data bleeding into student dashboard after role switch

Root cause 1 (routing): role state was not reset on logout/forceLogout,
so after HOD logs out the role remained 'hod'. When a student then logs
in, RoleDashboardRedirect briefly sees role='hod' and redirects to the
HOD dashboard before the useEffect updates role to 'student'.
Fix: setRole('student') added to both logout() and forceLogout() in
AuthContext.tsx.

Root cause 2 (cache): The queryClient.clear() inside MainLayout fired
unreliably — MainLayout unmounts on redirect to /login so the effect
sometimes never ran.
Fix: New CacheClearer component in App.tsx watches user.id via a ref
and calls queryClient.clear() synchronously whenever the user identity
changes (login, logout, or role switch), before any re-render routing.

fix(auth): wire JWT revocation — logout route + invalidate on delete/demote/password

Token revocation was an open gap: a deleted or demoted user's JWT stayed valid
for up to 24h, and there was no logout.

- middleware/auth.js: add an in-memory token denylist + per-user invalidation
  cutoff. authenticate() now rejects logged-out tokens and any token whose `iat`
  predates the user's invalidation (delete / role / school / password change).
  Sets req.token; exports logoutToken + invalidateUser.
- server.js: add POST /api/auth/logout (revoke presented token); invalidate the
  user on change-password, on DELETE /api/admins/:id, and on PUT /api/admins/:id
  when role/schoolId/password change.
- change-password now ends all sessions for the user (secure default) — parent
  doc updated to send the user back to login afterward; logout documented too.
- tests: logout succeeds and the reused token is rejected (401 revoked). 36 pass.

Note: revocation state is in-memory (resets on restart, per-instance). For
multi-instance / restart-safe revocation, back it with Redis or a tokenVersion
column.

fix: reset per-user UI state when the authenticated user changes

MobilityChoicesView built its DataTable once, with role-specific columns,
and on every later render only reloaded its data. After logging out and
back in as a user with another role (without a page refresh) the new
user got the previous role's table (a professor saw the student columns
and actions, and vice versa) until a hard refresh.

app.setUser() now publishes 'userChanged' when the user or role changes;
the view drops its table and resets the filter, and render() rebuilds
the table whenever it was built for another role. The debug user label
is refreshed on login/logout too.

API GET responses were also cacheable: jQuery caches GETs by default and
the legacy RoutingServlet sent no Cache-Control header. Disable the
jQuery cache and send "Cache-Control: no-store" on every API response.

Fixes #20

commit.message:
feat(auth): Phase 1 — real authentication with bcrypt + JWT session cookies

Replace the client-side fake login (one shared password, self-selected role
via dropdown, role trusted from an X-User-Role header) with real server-side
authentication.

Server:
- users table gains password_hash + must_change_password (idempotent ALTERs);
  seedUsers.cjs provisions one bcrypt account per canonical role (username =
  role, default password, forced change on first login).
- New /api/auth routes: login (rate-limited, bcrypt verify, aktif check,
  last_login + audit), logout, me, change-password.
- Identity now comes from a signed JWT in an httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie.
  middleware/auth.cjs verifies the cookie; requireRole/getRole contract is
  unchanged so no route handler changed. The spoofable X-User-Role header is
  honored only when ALLOW_HEADER_ROLE=1 (off by default; set for the
  integration test). Legacy-path RBAC middleware and /whoami now read the
  verified identity instead of the raw header.
- cookie-parser + credentialed CORS wired in; auth routes mounted.

Frontend:
- api.js: same-origin base, credentials:'include', drop the self-declared role
  header, add auth calls, emit auth:unauthorized on 401 so the app falls back
  to login.
- Login.jsx: real credentials, role dropdown and demo-password check removed.
- AppContext: hydrate session from /auth/me on boot, login()/logout() helpers,
  global 401 → logout listener.
- TopBar: logout hits the server to clear the cookie.

Verified: curl flow (login/me/logout, spoofed header rejected, mgr can't
reset); Playwright browser smoke (login renders, wrong password errors, login
loads app shell, cookie httpOnly, session survives reload) 8/8; reports suite
30/30.

commit.message:
Fix flaky authorization matrix test under -race

TestAuthorizationMatrix shared one fixture for all endpoints. The matrix also
calls POST /auth/logout with every role token, which revokes that user's
tokens issued before the current second. When the logout fell into the next
second (slow CI with -race), every later endpoint returned 401.

Each endpoint now gets a fresh fixture, so session-ending side effects
(logout, password change, account/restaurant/courier deletion) cannot leak
into other checks. Add TestLogoutRevokesEarlierTokens, which waits for the
next second and verifies logout revokes earlier tokens without affecting
other users.

Add role-based auth guards and bfcache handling

Implements role-based authorization throughout the app to prevent unauthorized access when users navigate back after logout. Changes include:

- Add role_name to JWT payload and fetch clean role name from database table during login/OTP verification
- Add role verification checks in middleware.ts to enforce role-based access to portal routes
- Fix bfcache (browser back/forward cache) issues on logout with hard redirect and BfCacheBuster component
- Update school-admin layout to verify role_name instead of role_id
- Add Cache-Control header in middleware to prevent bfcache storage

fix: resolve role-switching stale session issues across all 3 sub-apps

When a user logs out of one role and logs into another on the same
browser, stale client-side state caused wrong permissions and leftover
data. This commit fixes 4 root causes:

1. Admin (admin/): Logout now calls POST /api/auth/logout on the server
   and invalidates the cached auth check, so a stale 'manager' result
   doesn't briefly allow the login page to redirect back into /app.
   Router guard now re-validates the session server-side on every
   navigation instead of trusting a client-side sessionStorage flag.

2. Backoffice (backoffice/): Added revalidate() method to the auth
   store that re-calls /api/auth/me and detects if the logged-in user
   changed. AppLayout now listens for visibilitychange and focus events
   to catch session changes when the tab regains focus (shared machine
   scenario). On 'ended' → redirect to /login; on 'changed' → reload.

3. POS cart cleanup (pos/): auth.logout() now clears
   localStorage key 'fufut.pos.cart.v1' so the next user doesn't see
   the previous user's cart items.

4. POS in-memory state (pos/): AppLayout.handleLogout() now calls
   useOrderStore().resetFull() before auth.logout() to clear the
   in-memory Pinia cart state.

Also removes a hardcoded fallback password in admin LoginView that
bypassed server-side auth when the backend was unreachable.
